Information.Description: 17alpha-hydroxyprogesterone is a 17alpha-hydroxy steroid that is the 17alpha-hydroxy derivative of progesterone. It has a role as a metabolite, a progestin, a mouse metabolite and a human metabolite. It is a 17alpha-hydroxy-C21-steroid, a tertiary alpha-hydroxy ketone and a 17alpha-hydroxy steroid. It is functionally related to a progesterone.
